name: calm-connect
description: The AI companion to Calm Compliance: explore your sites, premises, work, compliance records, and people using your existing access.

interface.longDescription:
Calm Connect is the AI companion to Calm Compliance (calmcompliance.com), the platform for premises, maintenance, compliance, and people. Ask questions about your organisation's sites and records directly from your AI assistant.

What you can do:

- See what needs attention: outstanding issues and requests, overdue work, upcoming reviews, and expiring records. Compare attention across connected sites.
- Explore premises: find locations and assets, check vehicle MOT dates, and gather an asset's open tickets, due work, and linked documents.
- Find compliance records: look up published policies, risk assessments, hazardous materials, equipment risk profiles, adopted standards, and requirement gaps.
- Check people and contractors: find site role holders, training and accreditation expiries, and contractor insurance dates.
- Prepare for inspections, contractor visits, and meetings with compact packs drawn from your accessible records.
- With optional Write access, update existing issues and requests, start work orders, or complete, skip, or cancel work orders when you ask.

Try asking: "What needs attention at this site this month?", "Tell me about boiler 3", or "Help me prepare for a fire inspection on Friday."

Sign in with your Calm account and choose the sites the connection may use. Available tools follow your organisation's modules and your existing permissions. Installing the plugin grants no access.

Documents return details and links rather than full text or uploaded files. Searches and packs may be capped or incomplete, and preparation packs do not certify compliance. Supported writes apply immediately in Calm and are audited as you. Setup, imports, uploads, and maintenance schedule configuration stay in Calm.
